$comment: Tuning T-2 (docs/DESIGN_Terrain_Combat_Tuning.md §3 layer 2) — every bt-range demo's PREMISES, as data beside the terrain they run on. DemoPremisesTests (Hrot.Core.Tests) evaluates each row against the shipped TKB, the generated reference library, the material library and THIS terrain's geometry, and requires a MARGIN from every threshold: a fire crossing's penetration / resistance must be ≤ 0.7 (stops) or ≥ 1.3 (passes) — never inside the 0.8–1.2 ramp ± 0.1; sight must be ≥ 0.6 or ≤ 0.4 (threshold 0.5 ± 0.1). A tuning change that breaks a demo fails HERE, naming the demo, the row and the numbers. Rounds: { tkbType, mount } = what that catalog unit fires (ParameterResolver) · { ammo, weapon } = the reference library's pair · { penetrationMm } = a literal. Rows: kind fire|sight, with from/to (a trace through this terrain) or material (+ thicknessM / count).

bt-wall-vs-fence.summary: a rifleman's rounds at a target behind the brick panel do nothing; behind the chain-link panel they hit

premises.id: the rifle round is stopped by the brick panel
the rifle round passes the chain-link panel
the target is seen through the chain-link
the target is not seen through the brick

bt-weapon-pair.summary: the steel plate stops the rifle and is defeated by the heavy machine gun's AP round (two LAUNCHER × AMMO pairs against one plate)

premises.id: the steel plate stops the 5.56 ball
the 12.7 AP defeats the steel plate

bt-window.summary: an observer outside House A sees the target through the window, not through the wall beside it, and the round goes through the window

premises.id: the window is clear for sight
the wall beside the window blocks sight
the round goes through the window
the brick wall beside it stops the round

bt-cover.summary: the sandbag wall stops rifle fire; the hedge hides but does not protect against an HMG

premises.id: the 12.7 AP goes through the hedge

bt-grenade-posture.summary: CE-1032 — an M67 bursts 5 m in front of the 0.5 m Low Wall: the STANDING man 3 m behind it takes fragments over the wall (chest and head clear it), the PRONE man beside him takes none

premises.id: a fragment to the prone man's hip is stopped by the Low Wall
a fragment to the prone man's back is stopped by the Low Wall
the standing man's chest clears the Low Wall from the burst
the standing man's head clears the Low Wall from the burst

bt-mortar-roof.summary: CE-1032 — an 81 mm bomb bursts on House A's roof: the man downstairs is spared (the slabs stop fragments and most of the blast), the man in the open courtyard where the second bomb lands is not

premises.id: a fragment from the roof burst is stopped by the roof slab
a fragment from the courtyard burst reaches the man in the open
